title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：politician　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 politician 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the clerk ① followed the politician that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the following was the whole of the month. The ② politician, meaning the leader itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a politician, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ politician in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ politician at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A politician, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the politician was the whole of the matter, meaning the ambition and not the leader. The ⑥ politician, meaning the ambition and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; politician, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a leader and an ambition. He said the ambition is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ politician had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ politician of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; politician, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ politician I remember is the leader recorded in the file, which closed in 1959 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ politician, my mother said in 1961, is the only leader that improves by being recorded; every politician, she said, is an ambition that has agreed to look like a leader. She said the ambition was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 政治家；政客（指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 政治家；政客（指那位政治家本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the politician 追随这一位政治家
D. n. 政治家；政客（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 政治家之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的政治家之事）
F. n. 政治家；政客（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 政治家、心术（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心术（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the politician that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The politician, meaning the leader itself and not the stamp
the politician at the far counter
the politician was the whole of the matter
the politician had become a line in a file
The politician of the whole thing
A politician, my mother said in 1961

answers.why: follow the politician 意为“追随这一位政治家”，1952 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一位政治家做了一遍。
politician 意为“政治家；政客”，指那位政治家本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
politician 意为“政治家；政客”，指办事处里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
politician 意为“政治家；政客”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
politician 意为“政治家、心术”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位心术就是那件事的全部。
politician 意为“心术”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位政治家，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
politician 意为“政治家；政客”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1957 年这一位成了卷宗里的一行。
politician 意为“政治家之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的政治家之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
politician 意为“政治家；政客”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一位，1959 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一位。
politician 为抽象总称，母亲 1961 年说，政治家是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的政治家。

那位政治家，指的是那位政治家本身而不是小小的印章，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。（politician）
